parameters.name: BackupSetId
parameters.description:
The ID of the backup file. You can call the [DescribeBackups](~~473823~~) operation to obtain the backup file ID.

- To specify multiple backup file IDs, separate them with commas (,), such as `12345,67890`.
- If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically performs a backup and runs cache analysis on the backup file.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Redis instance.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data node in the instance. Specify this parameter to query monitoring information of a specific node.
>If you specify the BackupSetId parameter, this parameter is ignored. You can call the [DescribeLogicInstanceTopology](~~473786~~) operation to query node IDs.

parameters.name: Separators
parameters.description: The delimiters used to identify key prefixes. You do not need to specify this parameter if the default delimiters `:;,_-+@=|#` are used.
